# G316 X 98 community plugin for SignalRGB

> Unofficial MIT-licensed community plugin that adds SignalRGB RGB control for the Logitech G316 X 98 keyboard (USB VID 0x046D, PID 0xC36B). Tested on a physical Turkish/ISO unit. Supports per-key RGB and the 30-zone RGB light bar.

This is an independent community project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Logitech or SignalRGB.

Languages:
- English: README.md
- Turkish / Türkçe: README_TR.md

Support metadata:
- The plugin is free and open source.
- The author accepts and welcomes optional voluntary tips from users who found the project useful.
- Payment is never required to use the plugin.
- Canonical support options and public donation details are in SUPPORT.md.

Primary files:
- README.md — project overview, compatibility, installation, and status.
- README_TR.md — Turkish project overview and installation guidance.
- Logitech_G316_X_98.js — stable SignalRGB plugin.
- SUPPORT.md — canonical optional-tip information in English and Turkish.
- docs/PROTOCOL.md — HID++ interoperability and protocol notes.
- docs/INSTALLATION.md — English installation and troubleshooting.
- docs/INSTALLATION_TR.md — Turkish installation and troubleshooting.
- docs/UPSTREAM.md — notes for proposing integration into SignalRGB.
- LICENSE — MIT License.
